en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a quiet street lined with tall historic brick houses in Bruges. The central building is a high, narrow Gothic facade with tall vertical windows; adjacent are other stepped‑gabled townhouses. A person in dark clothing walks along the cobbled street near a shop entrance filled with goods. Printed captions in French appear at the bottom margin.
